name: @gipity/audio-align
description: Forced alignment kit for Gipity apps: audio + lyrics -> word-level timing JSON. Demucs vocal isolation + MMS_FA alignment, runs as a Modal L4 GPU job. Useful for karaoke, subtitling, language learning, dubbing, lyric videos.

job_definitions.name: audio-align
job_definitions.description: Forced alignment: audio URL + lyrics -> word-level timing JSON. ~30-60s on L4 for a 3-min song.
